mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate (1.83%) is at a historically low level, indicating an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and the core inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5%, it indicates a monetary tightening cycle that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts (HOUST) above 1300.0 thousand units signals strong economic activity and consumer confidence, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST is above 1300.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of industrial production (INDPRO) at 108.67 (above 100) indicates strong supply-side economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are above 1300.0 and real sales of new homes (RSAFS) are above 500,000 million dollars, it indicates strong demand for housing and consumer confidence, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1300.0 and RSAFS > 500000, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery regime (UNRATE below 3.5% and PAYEMS growth above 0.5% in the past 3 months), the S&P 500 is expected to produce positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% (3-month), or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
